source.temporalNotes: The intended control snapshot is PSA 3Q 2026. Identities/classifications are from official directory tables captured on the stated date; several table headings still say 31 July 2025, while their footer links to the 30 September 2026 publication. Exact masterlist row verification remains pending because the XLSX request returned 403. Do not treat this as a fully audited 3Q 2026 workbook import or apply current assignments retroactively to historical evidence.

scope.included: All 82 provinces; all 33 source-listed HUCs and 5 ICCs; NCR's 16 cities and Pateros (cities overlap the HUC count); separately assigned Isabela City; and the eight BARMM SGA municipalities.
scope.excluded: Ordinary component cities, province-contained municipalities, barangays and map geometries are outside this first coverage-unit registry.
scope.parentSemantics: coverageParentCode and regionId are the current regional coverage assignment. provinceCode is null for these province/outside-province coverage units. sourceEncodedProvinceCode preserves an association encoded in a city PSGC, not a legal parent or a polygon-containment result. SGA is a statistical grouping, not an 83rd province.
scope.rolloutGrouping: Luzon then Visayas then Mindanao is the project delivery convention. MIMAROPA/Palawan is included in the Luzon phase; administrative membership, physical islands and ecological basins are distinct.
